annotations.text:
A · THE ROUTINE’S THREAD
A compute notice is not an answer: the host re-asks as the owner once it holds a usable credential (bounded to three, never while a newer run exists). The re-ask is an ordinary human trigger, so the thread wake carries the conversation and the server births the unit approved.

B · THE UNIT’S THREAD
The plan record says auto-approved · routine. The design round is approved by the routine too (server follow-up, one line in the thread), the build is offered mechanically, and the human reads a run.
